description: Corrected figure: the tissue signalling deficit in CBG deficiency is set by receptor saturation alone and is independent of downstream readout speed
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
Kd,K_ALB,Vp,CL = 30.,3.4,3.5,25./4.4
S0 = CL*10*(1+K_ALB)
def simulate(Bmax,Sf,T=24.,n=16001,KdR=5.,k_tx=1.5):
    def g(F): return (1+K_ALB)+Bmax*Kd/(Kd+F)**2
    F0=S0/(CL*(1+K_ALB)); R0=F0/(KdR+F0)
    def rhs(t,y):
        F=max(y[0],0.)
        return [(Sf(t)-CL*F*(1+K_ALB))/(Vp*g(F)), k_tx*(F/(KdR+F)-y[1])]
    ts=np.linspace(0,T,n)
    s=solve_ivp(rhs,(0,T),[F0,R0],t_eval=ts,rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10,max_step=0.02)
    return ts,s.y[0],s.y[1]
def stress(t,t0=.5,dur=.5,mult=6.,tau=.33):
    if t<t0: return S0
    if t<t0+dur: return S0*mult
    return S0*(1+(mult-1)*np.exp(-(t-t0-dur)/tau))
def train(t,period=1.,width=.12,amp=8.):
    ph=t%period; return S0*(1+(amp-1)*np.exp(-.5*((ph-.3)/width)**2))

ts,Fw,_ = simulate(700.,train); _,Fk,_ = simulate(0.,train)
labs=['7 min','28 min','2 h','8 h']; kts=[6.,1.5,.35,.087]
res={}
for KdR in [0.5,5.,20.]:
    v=[]
    for k in kts:
        t,_,Rw=simulate(700.,stress,KdR=KdR,k_tx=k); _,_,Rk=simulate(0.,stress,KdR=KdR,k_tx=k)
        v.append(np.trapz(Rk-Rk[0],t)/np.trapz(Rw-Rw[0],t))
    res[KdR]=v
print("output AUC ratio null/normal, rows = receptor Kd, cols =", labs)
for k,v in res.items(): print(f"  Kd {k:5.1f} nM: "+"  ".join(f"{x:.3f}" for x in v))
print("spread across a 70-fold range of readout half-lives, at fixed Kd:",
      ", ".join(f"Kd {k:g}: {max(v)-min(v):.3f}" for k,v in res.items()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.3))
m=(ts>=8)&(ts<=14)
ax[0].plot(ts[m],Fw[m],lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='CBG normal')
ax[0].plot(ts[m],Fk[m],lw=2,color='#b2283c',label='CBG null')
ax[0].set_xlabel('time (h)'); ax[0].set_ylabel('free cortisol (nmol/L)')
ax[0].set_title('Ultradian pulses: identical mean free cortisol,\n2.2x larger swings without CBG')
ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
t,_,Rw2=simulate(700.,stress,KdR=5.,k_tx=.35); _,_,Rk2=simulate(0.,stress,KdR=5.,k_tx=.35)
mm=t<=8
ax[1].plot(t[mm]-.5,Rw2[mm],lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='CBG normal')
ax[1].plot(t[mm]-.5,Rk2[mm],lw=2,color='#b2283c',label='CBG null')
ax[1].set_xlabel('time from stress onset (h)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('GR-driven transcript (a.u.)')
ax[1].set_title('Genomic readout, GR Kd 5 nM,\n2 h transcript half-life'); ax[1].legend(frameon=False)
for KdR,c in [(0.5,'#1a365d'),(5.,'#2b6cb0'),(20.,'#90cdf4')]:
    ax[2].plot(labs,res[KdR],'o-',lw=2,color=c,label=f'receptor Kd {KdR:g} nM')
ax[2].axhline(1,color='grey',ls='--',lw=1); ax[2].set_ylim(0.5,1.1)
ax[2].set_xlabel('half-life of the downstream readout')
ax[2].set_ylabel('output AUC, null / normal')
ax[2].set_title('Receptor affinity sets the deficit;\nreadout speed does not')
ax[2].legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
